_comment: BASE-OWNED curated GitHub-hosted Agent Skills (open SKILL.md standard) vendored into canonical .agents/skills so they load in EVERY session of every agent (Claude, Codex, etc.), including ephemeral cloud containers that do NOT auto-install marketplace/GitHub skills. This file is refreshed by update-base; do NOT add per-vault sources here (they'd be overwritten) — put those in .agents/skill-sources.local.json, which is never synced and is merged in by sync-skills.sh (local wins on name collision). Only list skills NOT already available in your agent's cloud. After editing, run: .agents/scripts/sync-skills.sh  (a SessionStart hook also refreshes stale/broken copies). Do NOT add author-specific skills with hardcoded local paths; hand-author repo-aware skills directly in .agents/skills instead (those aren't in the lock, so sync won't clobber them).

sources.name: compound-knowledge
sources.note: kw:* knowledge-work workflow (brainstorm -> plan -> confidence -> review -> work -> compound) + its research/review subagents.

sources.name: matt-pocock
sources.note: Matt Pocock's KNOWLEDGE-WORK / WRITING / OBSIDIAN skills only. His engineering set is intentionally excluded — if needed it belongs in a separate code-focused vault. 'include' cherry-picks specific skill dirs across his in-progress/ and productivity/ folders. 2026-08-06: upstream removed 'edit-article' and 'decision-mapping' (no successor), and renamed 'writing-great-skills' -> 'writing-for-agents' (same thesis, broadened to cover AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md) — include follows the rename. NOTE: sync-skills.sh does not warn when an 'include' entry no longer exists upstream, so a stale name here fails silently; re-check this list when a skill disappears from INDEX.md.
